name: Star Gold Corp.
summary: Star Gold Corp. operates as an early-stage enterprise focused on identifying, assessing, and exploring potential mining sites for valuable precious and base metals throughout the United States, including a stake in the Longstreet Property in Nye County, Nevada. Originally established in 2006 under the name Elan Development, Inc., the company rebranded to Star Gold Corp. in April 2008. Its corporate headquarters are located in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho.
